# Community Rule Column 3 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 3

---

**3:1** He shall not be reckoned among the righteous who walks in the stubbornness of his heart, for he regards darkness as the ways of light. Among the truly
**3:2** perfect he shall not be numbered. He cannot be purified by atonement offerings, nor cleansed by the waters of purification,
**3:3** nor sanctified in seas and rivers, nor made clean by any waters of washing. Unclean, unclean
**3:4** shall he remain all the days that he rejects the ordinances of God, refusing instruction in the community of His counsel.
**3:5** For by the spirit of God's true counsel are the ways of a man set right — all
**3:6** of his iniquities — so that he may behold the light of life. By the holy spirit of the community, in His truth,
**3:7** he is cleansed from all his iniquities; and by the spirit of uprightness and humility his sin is atoned;
**3:8** and by the submission of his soul to all the statutes of God his flesh is cleansed,
**3:9** that he may be sprinkled with the waters of purification and sanctified by the waters of cleanness. He shall direct his steps
**3:10** to walk in perfection in all the ways of God, as He commanded for His appointed times,
**3:11** turning aside neither to the right nor to the left, and not transgressing against any
**3:12** of His words. Then he shall be accepted through pleasing atonement before God, and it shall be for him a covenant of
**3:13** the everlasting community.
**3:14** For the Instructor, to instruct and to teach all the Sons of Light concerning the true nature
**3:15** of all the children of man, according to all the kinds of their spirits with their distinguishing signs, concerning their deeds
**3:16** in their generations, and concerning the visitation of their afflictions together with the appointed times of their reward.
**3:17** From the God of knowledge comes all that is and all that shall be. Before they came into existence He established their entire design.
**3:18** When they come into existence at their appointed times, they fulfill their works according to His glorious design,
**3:19** and nothing can be changed. In His hand are the governing principles of all things, and He sustains them in all their needs.
**3:20** He created man to have dominion over the world, and He appointed for him two spirits
**3:21** in which to walk until the appointed time of His visitation: these are the spirits of
**3:22** truth and of deceit. From a spring of light come the origins of truth, and from a well of
**3:23** darkness come the origins of deceit. In the hand of the Prince of Lights is dominion over all
**3:24** the sons of righteousness; in the ways of light they walk. And in the hand of the Angel of
**3:25** Darkness is all dominion over the sons of deceit; and in the ways of darkness they walk.
**3:26** It is through the Angel of Darkness that all the sons of righteousness go astray, and all their sins and iniquities and guilt and transgressive deeds fall under his dominion,

---
*SOPHIA notes: The consensus closely follows LOGOS for this theologically critical column. Key decisions: (1) "set right" in 3:5 — a compromise between EMET's "atoned" and PNEUMA's freer rendering; the Hebrew kapparah encompasses both atonement and rectification. (2) "holy spirit of the community" in 3:6 — all three agents agree this is not a reference to the Holy Spirit as in later Christian theology, but the sanctifying spirit operative within the community. (3) "Instructor" (maskil) unanimous across all agents. (4) "God of knowledge" (3:17) retained as a divine title per EMET/LOGOS. (5) "Prince of Lights" and "Angel of Darkness" preserved as angelic titles — PNEUMA's slight variations ("Prince of Light" singular) normalized to the Hebrew plural. (6) "Sons of Light" maintained over PNEUMA's "Children" for series consistency. (7) The deterministic theology of 3:17-19 is preserved faithfully across all versions.*
